# thetalake_workspace (Data Source)

The workspace data source enables lookup of workspace IDs by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "thetalake_workspace" "example" {
  name = "East Region Sales"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the workspace to look up

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) A description of the workspace
- `id` (Number) The workspace ID
